texts:
Saturday's notes are about who sits Sunday and who gets the work, team by team.

Keenan Allen is ruled out for London with the groin.

Josh Downs is WR15 for me @WAS, a WR2.

Let's dive in.
#ForTheShoe #RaiseHail

Josh Downs has seen 3, 9 and 11 targets since Indianapolis lost its deep receiver to IR. WR15 for me, a WR2.

Tyler Warren drew 10 targets in Week 3. TE4 for me @WAS.
#ForTheShoe #RaiseHail

Keenan Allen (groin) is out for London after a Friday DNP.

Pivot to Wan'Dale Robinson. He drew 11 targets vs NYG. WR38 for me @BAL, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
#ForTheShoe #TitanUp #NYGiants #RavensFlock

Terry McLaurin (hamstring) is questionable, and Washington's beat reporting says he is likely to miss London. WR40 for me only if active; check the 8:00 AM ET inactives.

Stefon Diggs is WR27 for me vs IND, a high-end WR3.
#RaiseHail #ForTheShoe

Marcus Mariota starts with Jayden Daniels (elbow) out. QB17 for me vs IND, a streamer.

Jacory Croskey-Merritt played 57 percent of the snaps in Week 3, and Rachaad White is out. RB24 for me, an RB2.
#RaiseHail #ForTheShoe

Carolina elevated a practice squad receiver Saturday, the move its coach tied to Jalen Coker (quad) sitting. Coker is outside my top 50 receivers either way.

Darren Waller drew a team-high 8 targets in Week 3. TE18 for me vs DET, a streamer.
#KeepPounding #OnePride

Tetairoa McMillan ran 92 percent of Carolina's routes in Week 3. WR12 for me vs DET, borderline WR1/WR2 this week.

Chuba Hubbard had 19 of the 23 back carries on 84 percent of the snaps. RB12 for me, borderline RB1/RB2.
#KeepPounding #OnePride

Carolina has both starting corners on IR.

Jameson Williams caught 10 for 127 in Week 3 with no touchdown. WR28 for me @CAR, a high-end WR3.

Jared Goff is QB8 for me.
#OnePride #KeepPounding

Mike Evans (ribs) is a game-time decision after side work only Friday. Monitor the SF inactives at 2:55 PM ET and have a 4:25 PM receiver ready.

George Kittle caught 6 for 82 and two scores vs ARI. TE3 for me vs DEN.
#FTTB #BroncosCountry #BirdGang

J.K. Dobbins had 17 of Denver's 20 back carries in Week 3 and is at 3.5 a carry. RB32 for me @SF, a low-end RB3.

RJ Harvey ran 16 routes on 34 dropbacks with 7 targets. RB30 for me, a high-end RB3 in PPR.
#BroncosCountry #FTTB

Jeremiyah Love played 64 percent of Arizona's snaps in Week 3 with 21 of the backs' 23 carries. RB11 for me @NYG, borderline RB1/RB2.

Michael Wilson drew 17 targets in Week 3. WR22 for me, a WR2.
#BirdGang #NYGiants

Baltimore lost both centers in Rio, and Derrick Henry ran 11 times inside for 23 yards in Week 3. He has 6 touchdowns in three games. RB6 for me vs TEN.

Zay Flowers is questionable after a limited Friday. WR9 for me; have a 1 PM receiver ready.
#RavensFlock #TitanUp

Breece Hall is out, and Braelon Allen played every snap after Hall left in Week 3. RB20 for me @CHI, an RB2.

Kenyon Sadiq (back) is questionable after running 58 percent of the routes at DET. TE14 for me, a borderline start this week.
#JetUp #DaBears #OnePride

Luther Burden III has a 25 percent target share and drew 32 percent of the targets in Week 3. WR24 for me vs NYJ, a WR2.

Colston Loveland has 9 targets in three games on 71 percent of the routes. TE15 for me, a streamer.
#DaBears #JetUp

Jaylen Wright practiced in full and is listed first on Miami's depth chart @MIN. Stash him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB.

Ollie Gordon II played 82 percent of the snaps with Wright out. RB35 for me, a low-end RB3; sit him.
#PhinsUp #Skol

Justin Jefferson (ankle) is out vs MIA.

Pivot to Jordan Addison. He drew 9 of Minnesota's 29 throws in Week 3. WR25 for me, a high-end WR3.
#Skol #PhinsUp

Puka Nacua (hip) plays @PHI in his first game since Week 1, with his snaps possibly limited. WR11 for me, borderline WR1/WR2.

DeVonta Smith is out for Philadelphia. Pivot to Dontayvion Wicks, WR32 for me, a low-end WR3.
#RamsHouse #FlyEaglesFly

Seattle put Jadarian Price (chest) on IR Saturday.

Emanuel Wilson ran for 92 yards on 21 carries in Week 2 when Price left. RB31 for me vs LAC, a low-end RB3.

Ladd McConkey (foot) is questionable. WR39 for me if active, a dart throw.
#Seahawks #BoltUp

Kenneth Walker III played 73 percent of the snaps with 18 of the 24 back carries in Week 3. RB3 for me @LV.

Rashee Rice drew 9 of 24 throws. WR17 for me, a WR2.
#ChiefsKingdom #RaiderNation

Bucky Irving practiced in full Friday after two limited days with the glute. RB19 for me vs GB, an RB2.

Christian Watson has a 24 percent target share and a touchdown in every game. WR10 for me @TB.
#GoBucs #GoPackGo

Bhayshul Tuten had 15 of the 26 back carries in Week 3. RB21 for me @CIN, an RB2.

Joe Burrow threw 37 times for 282 and 3 touchdowns at PIT. QB4 for me vs JAX.
#DUUUVAL #WhoDey #HereWeGo

Every note from Saturday is on the Pass page, and the updated Menu and Prep Notes are on the site.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Sunday's inactives and pivots, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/pass.html
